steps.name: build a 7x7 wooden house: floor, walls, a door, a roof
steps.eval: local m = game.maps.current() local x0, z0, size = 120, 120, 7 local log = {} for x = x0, x0 + size - 1 do   for z = z0, z0 + size - 1 do     local edge = (x == x0 or x == x0 + size - 1 or z == z0 or z == z0 + size - 1)     local door = (z == z0 and x == x0 + 3)     if door then       game.build.instant(m, "Door", x, z, { stuff = "WoodLog" })     elseif edge then       game.build.instant(m, "Wall", x, z, { stuff = "WoodLog" })     else       game.maps.set_terrain(m, x, z, "WoodPlankFloor")     end     if not edge or door then end   end end for x = x0, x0 + size - 1 do for z = z0, z0 + size - 1 do game.maps.set_roof(m, x, z, "RoofConstructed") end end return "built"

steps.name: furnish it, add three colonists, food and wood
steps.eval: local m = game.maps.current() local out = {} local function put(def, x, z, stuff, rot)   local ok, err = pcall(game.build.instant, m, def, x, z, { stuff = stuff, rotation = rot or 0 })   out[#out + 1] = def .. "@" .. x .. "," .. z .. "=" .. (ok and "ok" or tostring(err):sub(1, 60)) end put("Bed", 122, 124, nil, 0) put("Bed", 124, 124, nil, 0) put("Table2x2c", 122, 122, "WoodLog") put("DiningChair", 121, 122, "WoodLog", 1) put("DiningChair", 124, 122, "WoodLog", 3) put("TorchLamp", 123, 125, nil) for i = 1, 3 do   local p = game.pawns.generate({ kind = "Colonist", faction = "player", map = m, x = 121 + i, z = 121 })   out[#out + 1] = "colonist " .. p.name end pcall(game.things.spawn_at, "MealSimple", m, 125, 121, { count = 30 }) pcall(game.things.spawn_at, "WoodLog", m, 125, 123, { count = 100 }) return table.concat(out, "; ")

steps.name: let about two game hours pass
the house counts as a room and the colonists are alive
steps.eval: local m=game.maps.current(); local rooms={}; for _,r in ipairs(game.maps.rooms(m)) do if r.cells==25 then rooms[#rooms+1]=r.role end end; local n=0; for _,p in ipairs(game.query.pawns({map=m, faction='player'})) do n=n+1 end; return 'colonists='..n..' house='..table.concat(rooms,',')
